lines.v1: In 2024, Redis moved from a permissive open source license to source-available licenses.
lines.v2: In response, the Linux Foundation and the community forked the last open source version as Valkey.
lines.v3: Valkey stays compatible: the same protocol, the same commands, and the same client libraries.
lines.v4: So moving between them is usually just a change of address.
lines.v5: Valkey is developed in the open, with backing from major cloud providers.
lines.v6: Choose by your license needs, your cloud's managed offering, and the features you rely on.
